design: Use repeat 9, the remaining unscored archive member at this device and setting. Use the previously fixed five-sample I/Q decoder, disjoint 50-step windows, and the forecasts already in return-routes-replay.json. Apply exactly the same windows to every retention stride.
criterion: Qualify each observable and starting level separately for this matched setting and 50-step horizon if all four grid comparisons differ from the observed frequency by at most one percentage point. This is a point-error requirement on a held trace, not a confidence interval, and it does not qualify any other device, decoder, time horizon, or continuous first-exit probability.
